summary: Ubuntu 24.10 (Oracular Oriole) was released on 10 October 2024. Features: GNOME 47, kernel 6.11, further App Center and snap/deb refinements. The oriole is a striking bird; 'oracular' suggests wisdom and foresight. Interim release with 9-month support.
notes: Standard support until 2025-07-10. Kernel 6.11. Part of the O series leading to 26.04 LTS Resolute Raccoon.
